name: Kanzuki Menou
source:
The vice student council president is as cool and beautiful as ice.

His ruthless nature towards his opponents means no one openly makes a fuss about him, but behind the scenes, he's just as popular as [url=/c16949]Takaho[/url]...

Takaho, the student council president, and [url=/c16948]Kisaki[/url] are in the same class.

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060629221246fw_/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/akiiro_cyara.html]official website[/url]]
